assertion_review.would_fail_when: the dispatch writes the roster through the run store, which moves the auxiliary version; load_auxiliary returns (payload, version) and write_members returns the bumped version, so a write between the two reads makes the pair differ.

docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-crew-members.html:26 non-blocking: the instrument-sanity paragraph reports a probe that moved the snapshot from version 1 to version 2 but names no script or log recording it, so the claim that a roster write is visible to the assertion rests on prose alone.
